items.headline: FMRB executive order classified-annex response clock
items.diff_narrative: Sunday held the post-briefing record with NIST and CISA having filed only early acknowledgements of receipt and no substantive responses over the business-quiet weekend. Monday, the first full business day, advances the ten-business-day clock into its third calendar day and adds the first substantive submission: NIST Director Locascio's office filed, with the CISA Director's office and the remaining six witnesses confirming responses are in drafting against the deadline now fixed at Friday May 22. Just Security restates that the classified-annex question set is the last open procedural gate, and the House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee's parallel joint-resolution draft moves from circulating to slated for a markup-scheduling decision this week.

items.headline: Cyber-evaluation reciprocity perimeter at fifteen jurisdictions
items.diff_narrative: Sunday held the fifteen-named-candidate count flat with OECD GENAI member-state comment submissions past the halfway mark of the cohort. Monday opens the business week with the count still at fifteen and the substance unchanged, but the schema-comment metric advances: secretariat-reported member-state submissions on the finalized attestation field schema have now passed two-thirds of the named candidate cohort, on schedule for the June 2-6 plenary. Qatar's 270-day national-consultation window rolls from its first weekend into its first full week, and no third Gulf Cooperation Council member has signalled adjacent-track interest.

items.headline: n8n CVE-2026-21858 exposure taper before May 21 deadline
items.diff_narrative: The day-seventeen Sunday scan rolls to day-eighteen with the federal-civilian remediation deadline stepping from T-minus-four to T-minus-three business days. The descent resumes its steeper weekday slope after the weekend taper: internet-exposed pre-1.121.0 instances fall from roughly 1,920 to 1,640, the residual unpatched long-tail share eases from about 14 percent to about 12 percent, and Censys exploitation telemetry ticks back up from 1.4x to roughly 1.7x baseline as commodity-tier exploit-kit volume returns to its weekday tempo. The new development is the CISA federal-civilian operational directive carrying the eleven-CVE Trail of Bits agent-loader taxonomy, which cleared the OMB queue Friday and published Monday morning.

items.headline: Monday arxiv checkpoint-provenance paper extends loader verification to the training surface
items.diff_narrative: A fresh Monday arxiv release, 2605.07588, opens the research week by extending the loader-verification line from the inference-time agent-loader surface to the local-fine-tuning training surface. Framed as a forward extension of the consolidated 2605.07241 framework and its 2605.07412 empirical companion rather than a fresh model, it formalizes a signed-checkpoint provenance chain that binds a training run's intermediate checkpoints to the manifest-allowlist and intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization surfaces, and reports a low single-digit-percentage overhead on a multi-GPU fine-tuning run. Simon Willison characterizes it as the verified-reference plus measured-overhead pairing moving upstream into the training pipeline, giving local-fine-tuning stacks a citable provenance model aligned with the framework cohort's mid-June default window.

items.headline: MCP-server attack-surface telemetry holds above 90 percent
items.diff_narrative: Sunday held cross-vendor agentic-AI control-plane visibility above 90 percent with the credential-extraction median at 5 minutes for a sixth consecutive day. Monday holds the line as enterprise security operations resume for the week: the 5-minute median holds for a seventh consecutive day with the unprotected-versus-protected gap near 67x, and Defender-for-Cloud quarantine on net-new MCP servers ticks from 47 percent to 48 percent — an eighth consecutive day of expansion. Cisco-Astrix identity-gateway tenancy edges from roughly 2,390 to roughly 2,420 and Akamai SkyAtlas MCP-firewall from roughly 1,375 to roughly 1,390 as the weekday provisioning rate resumes.

items.headline: Cerebras CBRS first re-rating session for the consolidation base
items.diff_narrative: Sunday was a second business-quiet hold after Friday's $198.60 four-consolidation-day close, with the desk preview cohort flagging Monday's open as the first re-rating opportunity. Monday delivers that session: the market opens the new trading week with the first re-rating of the four-day consolidation base, the five-desk analyst spread carrying into the open unchanged inside the roughly $185-to-$235 band, institutional-buyside net position near 37 percent of float, and the Saudi Aramco Digital MoU and Saudi PIF contingent-secondary windows holding. The desk cohort now treats the Monday session as the resolution point for whether the base re-rates higher or holds flat into the May 21 Alphabet analyst day.

items.headline: Mag-7 print-cycle preview ahead of the May 21 Alphabet analyst day
items.diff_narrative: The Alphabet analyst day steps from Sunday's T-minus-four to T-minus-three calendar days, and the analyst-day run-up window the cohort had named for Monday's open is now open. The six-desk preview cohort nudges the Alphabet Q2 AI Services 10-Q footnote breakout probability from 87 percent to 88 percent — a one-point uptick as desks reopened — with the Friday SEC Corp Fin fourth sample comment letter the settled disclosure-precedent input. On the AI-accelerator IPO track, Tenstorrent's first-round comment-letter response holds in the standard staff-review interval ahead of a likely second-round letter with the early-August public-filing target intact, and SambaNova's bookrunner roster holds at six with the confidential-submission target at the final week of June.

items.headline: Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 registry growth and gated-tenant resumption
items.diff_narrative: Day ten rolls to day eleven with the second-week growth normalization continuing — published skills rise from roughly 29,180 to 31,050 (+6.4 percent, a fifth consecutive sub-7-percent reading) and auto-quarantined Mythos-class skills go from 65 to 68. The notable shift is the Mythos-Preview gated cohort: held at 64 with no weekend signings on Sunday, it adds two enterprise customers to reach 66 on the Monday business-week open — the first signings since the weekend pause, with the new entrants in the Continental European public-sector tier. The verification harness's cross-tenant compositional safety check holds under 55 seconds and reproduces across all 66 gated tenants.

items.headline: vLLM v0.11.4 stable cut publishes on the targeted Monday
items.diff_narrative: Sunday confirmed the v0.11.4 release branch frozen for the targeted Monday May 18 stable cut. Monday delivers it: vLLM publishes the v0.11.4 stable tag, promoting the release candidate that carried the full five-surface agent-loader mitigation set to a stable build with the release branch unfrozen and the mitigation set on by default. The Yotta Labs throughput gap narrows from roughly 2.7 percent to roughly 2.2 percent — about 19,100 tok/s on v0.11.4 stable versus about 19,520 tok/s on SGLang RadixArk v0.5.9, the tightest of the benchmark cycle — with a scheduler tweak folded into the final tag, and Cloudflare Infire holds L40S edge-tier parity at 1.00x through the stable release.

items.headline: Unsloth ships a new MoE router-only LoRA path
items.diff_narrative: Sunday's changelog was a small weekend NCCL stability fix closing a rank-imbalance edge case. Monday's changelog opens the business week with a feature update rather than a fix: a faster Mixture-of-Experts router-only LoRA path that lowers peak combined VRAM on large-expert-count training, completing a single-node octa-Hopper run on the DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B recipe at roughly a 4 percent peak combined VRAM reduction against the prior week via a reworked expert-gradient bucketing layout. The community DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B recipe draws a ninth Hacker News reproduction — a dual-RTX 5090 consumer workstation completing the router-only run on the new path at roughly 5.5 percent peak combined VRAM, down from Sunday's roughly 6 percent on the prior path.

items.headline: Mistral AI Workflows adds an eighth central-government reference
items.diff_narrative: Sunday held the sovereign-cloud central-government reference count at seven with no fresh estate selection over the business-quiet weekend. Monday resumes estate-selection activity: the Netherlands Belastingdienst joins the prior seven references — France DGFiP, Germany, UK HMRC, Italy, Spain AEAT, Portugal, and Belgium — as the first fresh central-government selection since the weekend pause, lifting the count to eight. Paid Workflows tenancy edges from roughly 394 to roughly 401 enterprise customers and daily executions from roughly 7.2M to roughly 7.4M, and the five-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix holds its first-week-of-June general-availability target with the conformance suite green across all five vendors.

items.headline: OpenAI per-org agent registry extends to a ninth Indo-Pacific region
items.diff_narrative: Sunday held the per-org agent registry general-availability footprint at eight Indo-Pacific regions with no fresh extension over the weekend. Monday resumes regional GA activity: the Malaysia cloud region joins the prior eight — Singapore, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand, India, Indonesia, Taiwan, and Vietnam — as the first fresh extension since the weekend pause, lifting the footprint to nine regions, with GA-cohort tenancy edging from roughly 343 to roughly 351 enterprise customers. OpenAI also ships a Codex CLI v3.1.5 point release folding in two minor fixes on top of Saturday's v3.1.4, and the cohort reads the Malaysia addition as continuing to track the fifteen-jurisdiction reciprocity perimeter rather than expand ahead of it.

items.headline: Tenstorrent Galaxy rack shipments resume the weekday cadence
items.diff_narrative: Sunday added a small weekend top-up to roughly 168 cumulative Wormhole Galaxy racks. Monday resumes the seventh-wave weekday shipment cadence: a fresh batch lifts the cumulative count to roughly 177 racks against the 280-rack first-half target — about 63 percent fulfilled, up from about 60 percent — with additions across CoreWeave and Lambda Labs, an Asia-Pacific increment to Yotta Labs India, and a small first re-up to the European sovereign-cloud cohort of OVHcloud France and Hetzner Online Germany. AMD's Helios plus MI450 commitment book advances from near 10.1GW to near 10.4GW with a fresh weekday sovereign-cloud commitment, the first since the weekend pause.

items.headline: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 activates an eighth Fremont cohort
items.diff_narrative: Sunday held the active count flat at 84 units with no eighth cohort activated over the business-quiet weekend. Monday resumes the cohort-activation cadence: an eighth cohort of roughly twelve units comes online, lifting the active count from 84 to 96 of the disclosed 240-unit allocation — 40 percent reached, up from 35 percent — with cycle-time holding at the roughly 1.03x human-baseline envelope. The eighth cohort enters the Fremont automotive line on the same multi-station sealed parts-transfer chain the weekend three-line coordination runs rehearsed, with cross-cell coordination now folded into the standard line workflow. The Stellantis Detroit (June 8) and Volkswagen Wolfsburg (June 22) activation dates hold.

items.headline: Boston Dynamics Atlas extends toward a 120-hour continuous-operation milestone
items.diff_narrative: BMW Group's Spartanburg 30-unit Atlas pilot advances from Sunday's first North American 96-hour continuous-operation milestone toward a first North American 120-hour milestone on the under-body conveyor task with zero MTBF-impacting incidents. Volkswagen Wolfsburg's Atlas pilot edges from roughly 80 units to roughly 84 units on the body-shop welding-jig material-handoff task as the weekday shift resumes, the humanoid league-table OEM-adopter roster holds at six, and Hyundai Metaplant's Dangjin rolling-mill cycle-time improvement holds near 5.1 percent for a seventh consecutive within-band day, with the policy-distillation pipeline still running on the Tenstorrent Galaxy plus Unsloth router-only stack.
